info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Business Unit Management API
info.description: The Business Unit Management API enables organizations to efficiently manage their business units within the banking sector. This API supports the creation and configuration of various business units, allowing users to define their structure and roles. Ideal for banking institutions and financial service providers, this API streamlines the operation by permitting authorized users to add, modify, or delete business unit details. Use cases may include onboarding new departments, restructuring existing units, or enhancing operational workflows.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new business unit within the business control system, providing essential information needed for setup and management.

requestBody.description: This request body expects a JSON object that defines the parameters for managing business units within the business control system. The submitted data should adhere to the schema defined for operations related to business unit management.
